scope: independent source review and local HTTP fixtures only; no production or upstream calls

findings.issue: Removing a routed OAuth model originally made config validation fail after adapter mutation, leaving the old enabled source live.
findings.resolution: Preserve reviewed aliases and original declarations when pruning would invalidate them, disable affected source, return an explicit route-repair warning, and preserve unrelated provider scopes.

limits: Remote credential mutation followed by local persistence failure is reported explicitly and still requires operator reconciliation; unlike imports, delete/status does not compensate the remote mutation.
Automatically disabled connections stay disabled after credentials return; reviewed route repair and explicit re-enable are required.
